title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Brainstorm Force…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Brainstorm Force SureCart versions up to 4.12.1. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers with limited privileges to inject malicious scripts that can affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
